datasets.name: wf_growth
queryLines:
SELECT
  concat(base_year, ' to ', current_year) AS pair_label,
  base_year,
  current_year,
  step_no,
  step,
  amount
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      base_year,
      current_year,
      stack(
        4,
        1,
        concat('1. Revenue ', base_year),
        revenue_base,
        2,
        '2. Top customer',
        bar_top_customer,
        3,
        '3. Helium, other customers',
        bar_helium_excl_top_customer,
        4,
        '4. Rest of portfolio',
        bar_rest_of_portfolio
      ) AS (step_no, step, amount)
    FROM
      `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_growth_anatomy`
  )
ORDER BY
  base_year,
  current_year,
  step_no

queryLines:

datasets.name: kpi_latest
queryLines:
WITH k AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    window_end,
    CAST(revenue AS DOUBLE) AS revenue,
    CAST(cylinders AS DOUBLE) AS cylinders,
    CAST(price_per_cylinder AS DOUBLE) AS price_per_cylinder,
    CAST(customers AS DOUBLE) AS customers
  FROM
    `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_kpi_ytd`
),
c AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    k
  WHERE
    year
      = (
        SELECT
          MAX(year)
        FROM
          k
      )
),
p AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    k
  WHERE
    year
      = (
        SELECT
          MAX(year)
        FROM
          k
      )
        - 1
),
f AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    k
  WHERE
    year
      = (
        SELECT
          MIN(year)
        FROM
          k
      )
)
SELECT
  c.year AS current_year,
  c.window_end,
  c.revenue,
  c.cylinders,
  c.price_per_cylinder,
  c.customers,
  concat(
    format_string('%+.1f%%', 100 * (c.revenue / NULLIF(p.revenue, 0) - 1)),
    ' vs ',
    p.year,
    ' | ',
    format_string('%+.1f%%', 100 * (c.revenue / NULLIF(f.revenue, 0) - 1)),
    ' vs ',
    f.year
  ) AS revenue_note,
  concat(
    format_string('%+.1f%%', 100 * (c.cylinders / NULLIF(p.cylinders, 0) - 1)),
    ' vs ',
    p.year,
    ' | ',
    format_string('%+.1f%%', 100 * (c.cylinders / NULLIF(f.cylinders, 0) - 1)),
    ' vs ',
    f.year
  ) AS cylinders_note,
  concat(
    format_string('%+.1f%%', 100 * (c.price_per_cylinder / NULLIF(p.price_per_cylinder, 0) - 1)),
    ' vs ',
    p.year,
    ' | ',
    format_string('%+.1f%%', 100 * (c.price_per_cylinder / NULLIF(f.price_per_cylinder, 0) - 1)),
    ' vs ',
    f.year
  ) AS price_note,
  concat(
    format_string('%+.1f%%', 100 * (c.customers / NULLIF(p.customers, 0) - 1)),
    ' vs ',
    p.year,
    ' | ',
    format_string('%+.1f%%', 100 * (c.customers / NULLIF(f.customers, 0) - 1)),
    ' vs ',
    f.year
  ) AS customers_note
FROM
  c CROSS JOIN p CROSS JOIN f

datasets.name: channel_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT
  year(month_start) AS channel_year,
  ROUND(
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN NOT is_attributed THEN orders
        END
      )
      / NULLIF(SUM(orders), 0),
    1
  ) AS unknown_orders_share_pct,
  ROUND(
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN NOT is_attributed THEN revenue
        END
      )
      / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0),
    1
  ) AS unknown_revenue_share_pct
FROM
  `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_channel_month`
WHERE
  year(month_start)
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(year(month_start))
      FROM
        `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_channel_month`
    )
GROUP BY
  year(month_start)

datasets.name: overdue_now
queryLines:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  last_order_date,
  order_days,
  median_gap_days,
  silent_days,
  ROUND(silent_days / NULLIF(median_gap_days, 0), 1) AS times_own_rhythm,
  revenue_24m
FROM
  `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_customer_cadence`
WHERE
  scope = 'current'
  AND is_overdue
ORDER BY
  revenue_24m DESC

datasets.name: pair_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  concat(p.base_year, ' to ', p.current_year) AS pair_label,
  p.base_year,
  p.current_year,
  p.volume_effect,
  p.mix_effect,
  p.price_effect,
  p.price_offsets_volume_loss_pct,
  g.revenue_delta,
  g.growth_pct,
  g.top_customer_id,
  g.top_customer_share_of_growth_pct,
  g.growth_ex_top_customer_pct,
  g.growth_ex_helium_pct,
  c.customers_start,
  c.customers_lost,
  c.customers_new,
  c.customers_winback,
  c.customers_end,
  c.retention_pct,
  c.cylinders_lost,
  c.cylinders_new,
  c.cylinders_winback,
  c.cylinders_retained_up,
  c.cylinders_retained_down
FROM
  `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_pvm_bridge` p
    JOIN `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_growth_anatomy` g
      ON g.base_year = p.base_year
      AND g.current_year = p.current_year
    JOIN `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_customer_bridge` c
      ON c.base_year = p.base_year
      AND c.current_year = p.current_year

datasets.name: new_customers
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(year AS STRING) AS year_label,
  year,
  SUM(CAST(is_new_24m AS INT)) AS new_customers_24m,
  COUNT(*) AS active_customers,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(is_new_24m AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS new_share_pct
FROM
  `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_customer_year`
WHERE
  is_new_24m IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  year
ORDER BY
  year

datasets.name: kpi_index
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(year AS STRING) AS year_label,
  metric,
  index_value
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      year,
      stack(
        4,
        'Cylinders',
        CAST(idx_cylinders AS DOUBLE),
        'Revenue',
        CAST(idx_revenue AS DOUBLE),
        'Price per cylinder',
        CAST(idx_price AS DOUBLE),
        'Active customers',
        CAST(idx_customers AS DOUBLE)
      ) AS (metric, index_value)
    FROM
      `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_kpi_ytd`
  )
ORDER BY
  year,
  metric

datasets.name: backtest
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN is_overdue THEN 'Flagged overdue'
    ELSE 'Not flagged'
  END AS customer_group,
  COUNT(*) AS customers,
  SUM(CAST(returned_next_12m AS INT)) AS returned,
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CAST(returned_next_12m AS INT)), 1) AS returned_pct
FROM
  `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_customer_cadence`
WHERE
  scope = 'backtest'
GROUP BY
  is_overdue
ORDER BY
  is_overdue DESC

datasets.name: pvm_sku
queryLines:
SELECT
  concat(s.base_year, ' to ', s.current_year) AS pair_label,
  s.base_year,
  s.current_year,
  s.product_id,
  p.product_description,
  p.product_supergroup,
  p.gas,
  p.size_liters,
  s.cylinders_base,
  s.cylinders_current,
  s.price_base,
  s.price_current,
  s.volume_effect,
  s.mix_effect,
  s.price_effect
FROM
  `lindedata`.`gold`.`mart_pvm_sku_year` s
    JOIN `lindedata`.`gold`.`dim_product` p
      ON p.product_id = s.product_id

lines:
## Where do sales stand?

Revenue, cylinders, price and customers, 2017 to 2022. Every year is cut at Jan 1 to Nov 21.

title.value: Price up 44%, cylinders down 36% since 2017: revenue ends 7.5% lower
Fewer cylinders every year since 2018, at a higher price every year

lines: Why Jan 1 to Nov 21: full-year 2021 revenue was EUR 4.43M, while 2022 so far (to Nov 21) is EUR 4.08M. Compared on the same window, 2021 was EUR 3.96M, so 2022 is +3.1%. Comparing 2022 with the full year would show a false drop of 7.8%.

Key message: 2017 to 2022, revenue is down 7.5%, but the bridge shows price is doing all the work: EUR +1.58M from price, against EUR -1.57M lost to volume and mix. Price offsets 72.7% of the volume loss; the remaining 27.3% is the revenue gap. At SKU level, 6 of the 16 traded SKUs lost price.

frame.title: Price offsets the volume loss by

title.value: Where the price wins and losses sit (EUR per SKU)

frame.title: SKU detail: cylinders, price, and PVM effects

lines: Key message: of the EUR +123K growth from 2021 to 2022 (+3.1%), EUR +99K (80.6%) came from one customer. Excluding that customer, growth was +0.6%. Excluding helium, the portfolio actually shrank by -4.2%. 2021 to 2022 is one customer's story, not a broad recovery.

frame.title: Growth anatomy 2021 to 2022: top customer, helium, rest of portfolio (EUR)
Top customer share of the growth

lines: 2021 to 2022: the volume loss comes mostly from customers who stay but buy less (-15.7k cylinders), about three times the cylinders lost with customers who left (-5.1k). New customers keep falling: 618 in 2019, 456 in 2022 (-26%). New = no order in the previous 24 months. Message shown for the default selection.

frame.title: New customers per year (no order in the previous 24 months)
frame.description: 2017 and 2018 are absent on purpose: there is no 24-month history yet.

lines: 480 customers have been silent for more than twice their own ordering rhythm. They hold EUR 937k of revenue over the last 24 months. A year ago the same rule flagged 552 customers: 63% came back within 12 months, against 93% of the others. Use it as a call list, not as a churn forecast.

frame.title: Backtest: share that ordered again within 12 months
Customers to call first (largest 24-month revenue first)

lines: Channel labels are not stable, so this page shows a data problem, not customer behavior. PHONECALL fell from 49% of orders in 2017 to 2% in 2022; RETAIL SHOP rose from 0% to 36%; UNKNOWN SOURCE rose from 0% to 31%. The break is in Nov 2020 and partly reverses in Feb 2021: it looks like a labeling or process change (hypothesis). Only ECOMMERCE stays between 19% and 27%. Do not read channel behavior from this data.
